cr_data.provenance: (An American Place, New York, NY) (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Sold to Cleveland. Painted summer 1929." Whitney Archive (American Art Research Council Questionnaires) indicates, "Painted 1930." Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1929. Dated 1929 on basis of inclusion in 1930 New York (An American Place) exhibition. Reproduced in *The Bulletin of the Cleveland Museum of Art* (April 1937). Abiquiú Notebooks indicates orientation as here as well as upside down. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks, backing inscription.
